gates.requirement: The audible released song, actual player metadata, corresponding original cover and displayed canonical words agree.
A real foreground app changes from a music player to a real reading document while native lyrics continue through at least two actual cue changes.
The lyric panel remains near the upper-right screen edge at an ordinary desktop scale; no oversized central panel replaces the context.
The actual OS pointer enters the production view and reveals its native controls; any executed control action has real player readback and matching audio.
A second supported actual client is shown playing; no invented source metadata or unsupported logo is substituted.
Two equally sized native cards share the lyric material in the explicitly authorized filming copy, with readable full-opacity foreground content.
The real host ordering operation leads to the visible vertical card order change; desktop dragging is not falsely presented as supported.
An actual screenshot appears as a recognizable result in the native screenshot module.
Continuous frame inspection, 30fps conformance, complete decode, explicit BT.709 metadata and measured audio headroom pass.
Nearpane is the named product and the official site is accurate; the preview does not promise an unverified downloadable integrated release.
